title: Fix stale storage comment and unignored jit tmp directory
description:
A storage-layer comment claims config.toml is never auto-created, while the init command scaffolds it from the chosen hierarchy template. Separately, .jit/tmp/ is the one machine-local runtime artifact not gitignored.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-1: The storage init comment states where config.toml scaffolding actually happens (the init command layer)
- [ ] [hard] REQ-2: .jit/tmp/ is gitignored alongside the other runtime artifacts
